findings.description: The KMS key protecting the logs bucket omits enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the same key material is used indefinitely. This lengthens the exposure window and increases blast radius if the key material is ever compromised, and fails common key-management baselines for keys protecting log data.

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS applies the default key policy granting the account root full control, delegating key use and administration to any IAM principal in the account that is granted KMS permissions via IAM rather than to a least-privilege set of principals. This is a weaker-than-ideal default rather than an actively exposed key.
